points.title: 继承汗位
points.description: 忽必烈在1260年成为大蒙古国的可汗，他在和林宣布继承汗位。在此期间，他开始推行一系列改革，包括加强中央集权，改革税制，以及推广汉文化。这些改革为后来的元朝奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1260, Kublai Khan ascended to the throne of the Great Mongol Empire in Karakorum. During this period, he began to implement a series of reforms, including strengthening central authority, reforming the tax system, and promoting Han culture. These reforms laid the foundation for the later Yuan Dynasty.

points.title: 建立元朝
points.description: 忽必烈将都城迁至大都（今北京），并在此建立了元朝。他推行汉化政策，采用汉族的政治制度，并大力推广儒家思想。在他的统治下，元朝实现了对中国的统一，并成为当时世界上最强大的国家之一。
points.descriptionEn: Kublai Khan moved the capital to Dadu (modern Beijing) and established the Yuan Dynasty. He implemented Hanification policies, adopted Han political systems, and vigorously promoted Confucianism. Under his rule, the Yuan Dynasty unified China and became one of the most powerful countries in the world at the time.

points.title: 征服南宋
points.description: 忽必烈成功征服南宋，结束了长达数百年的中国南北分裂局面。这一事件标志着元朝对中国的完全统一，并使忽必烈成为中国历史上第一个非汉族的皇帝。
points.descriptionEn: Kublai Khan successfully conquered the Southern Song Dynasty, ending hundreds of years of north-south division in China. This event marked the complete unification of China by the Yuan Dynasty and made Kublai Khan the first non-Han emperor in Chinese history.

points.title: 推行汉化政策
points.description: 忽必烈在大都推行汉化政策，包括使用汉字，设立科举制度，以及推广儒家文化。这些政策促进了元朝的稳定和繁荣，但也引发了部分蒙古贵族的反对。
points.descriptionEn: In Dadu, Kublai Khan implemented Hanification policies, including the use of Chinese characters, establishing the imperial examination system, and promoting Confucian culture. These policies promoted the stability and prosperity of the Yuan Dynasty but also led to opposition from some Mongolian nobles.

points.title: 逝世
points.description: 忽必烈在大都逝世，享年80岁。他的去世标志着元朝的黄金时代的结束，并为后来的元朝衰落埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: Kublai Khan died in Dadu at the age of 80. His death marked the end of the golden age of the Yuan Dynasty and laid the groundwork for its later decline.

supporter.zh: 忽必烈被视为中国历史上伟大的皇帝之一，他的主要贡献包括统一中国，推行汉化政策，以及促进文化交流。他的精神遗产在于他的开放性和包容性，以及对多元文化的尊重。
supporter.en: Kublai Khan is regarded as one of the great emperors in Chinese history, with his main contributions including the unification of China, the implementation of Hanification policies, and the promotion of cultural exchanges. His legacy lies in his openness and inclusiveness, as well as his respect for multiculturalism.

critic.zh: 忽必烈的汉化政策虽然促进了元朝的稳定，但也引发了蒙古贵族的反对。此外，他的统治也存在着腐败和暴政的问题，这些问题最终导致了元朝的衰落。
critic.en: Kublai Khan's Hanification policies, while promoting stability in the Yuan Dynasty, also led to opposition from Mongolian nobles. Moreover, his rule was characterized by corruption and tyranny, issues that eventually led to the decline of the Yuan Dynasty.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，忽必烈被视为一个复杂的人物，他的统治既体现了蒙古帝国的扩张性，也展现了汉文化的包容性。在大众文化中，他常常被描绘为一个强大的皇帝，但同时也存在着对他的争议和批评。
objective.en: In the academic community, Kublai Khan is seen as a complex figure, whose rule reflected both the expansionist nature of the Mongol Empire and the inclusiveness of Han culture. In popular culture, he is often depicted as a powerful emperor, but there is also controversy and criticism surrounding him.

self.zh: 治国犹如治家，必先正己，然后物正。
self.en: Ruling a country is like managing a family; one must first correct oneself before others can be corrected.

others.zh: 忽必烈是蒙古帝国最伟大的征服者之一，他不仅统一了中国，还推动了文化的融合和交流。
others.en: Kublai Khan is one of the greatest conquerors of the Mongol Empire, not only unifying China but also promoting cultural integration and exchange.
